label: Trust PDP
info: Federation trust policy endpoint (ADR-19): answers every {peerDID, agreementCredential, direction, contractDID, targetState} POST to /trust-pdp according to a controllable flow-context mode (default 'allow'), the bootstrap dev/CI/BDD mutual-trust flow every DCS_TRUST_PDP_URL points at by default. POST /trust-pdp/mode steers the mode (allow/deny/silent); GET /trust-pdp/last returns the last captured request body, and GET /trust-pdp/last?contractDID=<iri> the last one captured for that contract. Operators replace or extend the decision function with dataspace-specific checks (peer allowlists as policy, trust lists, a Gaia-X Clearing House via the GXDCH compliance API) as backend lookups of their own endpoint.
